title: epic: pools database and Pools screen (change set pools-database)
description:
Tracking issue for the OpenSpec change set `pools-database` (branch `feat/pools`, folder `openspec/changes/pools-database`). Hand this issue to a coding agent: it lists every task and the order to do them in.

**Goal.** Pools move out of Settings into their own SQLite file, `pools.db`. The file holds the numbering plan (a reverse index of `setupdb.cdb`, keeping its country and operator ids), the A pools (brand names and short codes) and the content pools (`smpp-body` and `http-body`; no 160-character cap). The B number becomes a weighted rule written in the scenario and drawn from the plan. A new Pools screen replaces the Settings section. A clean break: no pool migration.

**Read first:** `proposal.md`, `design.md` (D1 to D8, the decisions taken in review, Q5), `specs/` and `tasks.md`. Validate with `openspec validate pools-database --strict`.

## Tasks, in order
- [ ] #93 Remove the pools from Settings (1.1-1.2). UI only; keep the old API and store until the new store lands.
- [ ] #94 Spike: read the real `setupdb.cdb`, time the reverse import (2.1-2.2). Read-only.
- [ ] #95 `pools.db` store, import and config (3.1-3.3)
- [ ] #96 Number rules in scenarios (4.1-4.3)
- [ ] #97 A pools and content pools (5.1-5.3)
- [ ] #98 `/api/pools` endpoints (6.1)
- [ ] #99 The Pools screen (7.1-7.3)
- [ ] #100 Validate, gates and archive (8.1-8.3). Last.

## Dependencies
```
#93 (independent, first MR)
#94 ─► #95 ─┬─► #96 ─┐
            └─► #97 ─┴─► #98 ─► #99 ─► #100
```

## Open point to settle with Trung before #97
Design Q5: the owner wrote "brand name -> 3 + 0". The change reads it as the short code and keeps the brand name at TON 5 / NPI 0. Confirm before coding the automatic TON/NPI.

## Rules for every task
Gates before each MR: `gofmt -l .`, `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`, and in `web/`: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test -- --run`, `npm run size`. Every change lands as a merge request against `main`; Trung merges it. Commit subjects: `type(scope): plain summary (#issue)`. Tick the matching task in `tasks.md` with its evidence.

title: epic: resource wizard (change set resource-wizard)
description:
Tracking issue for the OpenSpec change set `resource-wizard` (branch `feat/ui-resource-wizard-and-polish`, folder `openspec/changes/resource-wizard`). Hand this issue to a coding agent: it lists every task and the order to do them in.

**Goal.** Creating a resource becomes a wizard (Basics, Accounts, Behaviour for a server; Basics, Accounts for a client), editing shows the same steps as free tabs. A server may have no accounts. Saving a behaviour change on a running resource shows the restart warning. The create wizard is a component, so the later scenario wizard can open it in an overlay.

**Read first:** `proposal.md`, `design.md` (D1 to D8), `specs/` and `tasks.md` of the change set. Validate with `openspec validate resource-wizard --strict`.

## Tasks, in order
- [ ] #85 Verify the backend assumptions (tasks 1.1-1.3). Do first; blocks the protocol issues.
- [ ] #86 Shared Stepper component (2.1-2.2)
- [ ] #87 SMPP server and client wizard (3.1, 3.5)
- [ ] #88 HTTP server and client wizard (3.2, 3.5)
- [ ] #89 MNP server and client wizard (3.3, 3.5)
- [ ] #90 Restart warning when a behaviour change is saved (4.1, 3.4)
- [ ] #91 Manual, gates and archive (5.1-5.4). Last.

## Dependencies
```
#85 ─┐
#86 ─┴─► #87, #88, #89 (can run in parallel) ─► #90 ─► #91
```

## Rules for every task
Gates before each MR: `gofmt -l .`, `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`, and in `web/`: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test -- --run`, `npm run size`. Every change lands as a merge request against `main`; Trung merges it. Commit subjects: `type(scope): plain summary (#issue)`. Tick the matching task in `tasks.md` with its evidence. Follow-up (not here): the scenario wizard.
